claim: AWS Backup Vault Lock helps you prevent changes to backup lifecycle and prevent manual deletion of backups, and it implements safeguards that check you store backups with a Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) model.
question: What is AWS Backup Vault Lock?

values.display: prevent manual deletion of backups
Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) model

evidence.quote: AWS Backup Vault Lock is a feature that helps you prevent changes to backup lifecycle as well as prevent manual deletion of backups, helping you meet your compliance requirements. AWS Backup Vault Lock implements safeguards that verifies you are storing your backups using a Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) model.

claim: In a locked vault, AWS Backup denies any attempt to delete a backup or update its lifecycle properties, even from the root account user.

AWS Backup denies the operation

qualifiers.scope: vault with an active Vault Lock configuration

evidence.quote: If any user, including the root account user, attempts to delete a backup or update its lifecycle properties in a locked vault, AWS Backup denies the operation.

claim: Vault Lock is an optional configuration at the backup vault level with three properties: minimum acceptable retention days, maximum acceptable retention days and grace time.

minimum acceptable retention days, maximum acceptable retention days, and grace time

evidence.quote: AWS Backup Vault Lock is an optional configuration at the AWS Backup vault level and comprises three properties: minimum acceptable retention days, maximum acceptable retention days, and grace time.

claim: Once Vault Lock is activated, AWS Backup protects all newly created recovery points in the vault against deletion and lifecycle changes, and fails every backup job whose retention period does not meet the acceptable retention periods.
question: What does an activated Vault Lock protect, and what happens to backup jobs outside the retention range?

values.display: protect all newly created recovery points
fail all backup jobs with retention periods not meeting

evidence.quote: If you activate the AWS Backup Vault Lock configuration, then AWS Backup will protect all newly created recovery points in the vault against deletion and changes to their lifecycle. AWS Backup will also fail all backup jobs with retention periods not meeting the AWS Backup Vault Lock acceptable retention periods.

claim: Until the grace time expires you can update and remove the Vault Lock configuration, and once it expires AWS Backup will not allow any change to the configuration.

will not allow any change to the configuration

evidence.quote: With grace time, you can test the feature for a number of days you define. You can update and remove the AWS Backup Vault Lock configuration as long as the grace time has not expired. Once the grace time expires, AWS Backup will not allow any change to the configuration.

claim: Legal holds, also known as litigation holds, prevent backups from being deleted even if their retention period is over, and they stay in place until they are explicitly released.

remain in place until explicitly released

These holds prevent backups from being deleted, even if their retention period is over, and remain in place until explicitly released.
